about.description: RoboStrategy perpetual market on Lighter: RoboStrategy, Inc. (NASDAQ: BOT) is the first publicly-traded closed-end fund (CEF) dedicated to robotics and physical AI, listed on NASDAQ May 11, 2026. The fund provides public-market investors exposure to a concentrated portfolio of private, pre-IPO, and public robotics companies (disclosed holdings include Figure AI, Apptronik, Dyna Robotics, Standard Bots, and Dexmate), effectively bridging venture capital and public markets in a single ticker. The Lighter perp gives synthetic exposure to BOT's share price without owning fund shares or redemption rights. Max 3x leverage, cash-settled in USDC.
